text.p: These are the highlights of main stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian Trade Union Federation demands the government to start immediate talks on its intention to reduce some social benefits. This should be done before the final government proposal for amendment to the Labour Law is submitted to parliament.
- Macedonian ministry of economy will start issuing export permits to interested firms as of Thursday in line with the Trade agreement on textile products between the EU and Macedonia.

- Macedonia is to end talks with south Korean company Samsung by end September on possible investments in the metal company Feni from Kavadarci. Macedonia at the same time offered cooperation to other interested foreign companies. Samsung is not planning to assume Feni debts which amount to $300 million.

- Some fifty streets, around 150,000 square miles of road, to be reconstructed in Skopje by October, the largest area under reconstruction in the past thirty years. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
